Upgrade to Litesizer DIF 500 for the Price of DIF 100 
 Top-tier laser diffraction with no risk for four months
Switching particle sizing technology shouldn’t feel like a leap of faith. Anton Paar’s Upgrade Package makes transitioning to the Litesizer DIF laser diffraction particle analyzer simple, cost-effective, and worry-free. Enjoy best-in-class measurement performance, full support during method transfer, and a generous trial period that lets you validate results before you decide to switch.
Upgrade to the best laser diffraction instrument on the market.
Start your free trial
Premium for less: 
Get Litesizer DIF 500 with the Liquid Flow Imaging Module for the price of Litesizer DIF 100 when you trade in your old system. 
Four-month trial period:
Try Litesizer DIF 500 before you upgrade. You’ll receive learning materials and expert support from our specialists. You’ll also keep your current instrument during the trial.
Free return:
Trade in your old system and upgrade at the end of the trial or return Litesizer DIF 500 without any charge. It’s up to you.
AISQ+
For customers in regulated industries, trading in an existing instrument gets you the Analytical Instrument and System Qualification Package (AISQ+) at no additional cost.
 Start your risk-free trial today
Start your risk-free trial today - Litesizer DIF 500

 Particle Size Analyzers
Particle Size Analyzers
Particle analysis at the touch of a button
Although particle systems can be complex, measuring them doesn’t have to be. Choose from three different technologies to characterize particles from the nanometer to the millimeter range. 
The Litesizer DLS series leverages light-scattering technology to determine particle size, zeta potential, transmittance, molecular mass, and the refractive index of nano- and microparticles in liquid dispersions.
The Litesizer DIF series uses laser diffraction (LD) technology to measure the size of particles in both liquid dispersions and dry powders in the micro- and millimeter range.
Since the Litesizer DIA series is based on dynamic image analysis, it offers particle shape information alongside particle sizing. What’s more, you get full measurement flexibility with our powerful portfolio of different dispersion units.

Three techniques cover it all 
With different techniques, the Litesizer DLS series, Litesizer DIF series, and Litesizer DIA series cover the measurement of particle sizes from the lower nanometer to the millimeter range. Choose the right particle size analyzer based on your needs. 
Use the Litesizer DIF series to analyze particles ranging up to millimeter sizes in liquid or dry dispersions. You can analyze in liquid dispersions with Litesizer DLS instruments down to the nanometer range. With the Litesizer DIA series, you can also determine particle size and shape information while using either liquid, gravitational-fall, or compressed air dispersion units.
The Litesizer DLS series: Three instruments, up to six measuring modes 
Our Litesizers don’t just determine particle size via single-angle measurement or multi-angle particle sizing (MAPS). You can also determine particle concentration, zeta potential, molecular mass, transmittance, and refractive index. Fluorescence and polarization filters are available for all three measurement angles or for selected single angles – permitting types of analysis not possible with comparable particle size analyzers.
Litesizer DIF series: From First to Best 
The Litesizer DIF series offers advanced particle sizing from 10 nm to 3.5 mm, drawing on nearly 60 years of laser diffraction expertise. This laser diffraction particle size analyzer features a best-in-class optical setup with powerful 10 mW and 25 mW lasers and the widest range on the market of detected diffraction angles from 0.01°to 170°.
Litesizer DIA series: Dynamic image analysis at the touch of a button 
With the Litesizer DIA series, measure particle size and get shape information for millions of particles in just a few seconds. In just one step, quickly switch among three dispersion units – wet, dry, and free-fall – to access excellent dispersion of nearly any sample. Rely on automated features to minimize work and safety features that protect you from dangerous sample spread, and the instrument from damage.
Kalliope: Particle analysis software reducing operator involvement to a minimum 
Optimize your measurements with Kalliope and get your measurement started in just three clicks. Control all particle size analyzers in the portfolio with this software. Kalliope is intuitive software that displays all of your input parameters, measurements, and analyses in one digital space. With Kalliope, concentrate on what your particles are doing instead of trying to figure out how to use the instrument. Kalliope is 21 CFR Part 11-compliant for complete traceability of results.

The game-changer: Our portfolio of thermal analyzers 
The Julia DSC series’ patented air-cooling principle reaches temperatures down to -35 °C without the need for an external cooling device, while an innovative cooling module extends this to -170 °C. 
The powerful MCR 703 MultiDrive platform enables dynamic mechanical analysis of solid, soft, and liquid samples, covering bending, tension, compression, and torsion, as well as rheological measurements and thermomechanical analysis (TMA) – all with one instrument. 
Modular instruments for a wide variety of samples 
Expand the temperature range of the Julia DSC series to -170 °C by simply exchanging cooling modules. Increase your throughput with our custom-designed Julia DSC autosampler. With the MCR 703 MultiDrive, you can perform classic dynamic mechanical analysis with the additional option of sophisticated rheological measurements – supported by a range of measuring systems and accessories.
Multifunctional operating software 
Julia Suite – created by users for users – intuitively takes you through the DSC measurement process in four easy steps, all in one workspace. Guided methods and measurement wizards streamline your workflow. The sophisticated RheoCompass software for MCR 703 MultiDrive helps you find predefined or customized test templates, tailor tests and analysis definitions, export your data, and generate reports. Optional 21 CFR Part 11-compliant software packages and documentation are available for both Julia Suite and RheoCompass.
High-precision temperature control for thermal analysis 
Julia DSC thermal analyzers cover a temperature range from -170 °C to +700 °C while maintaining full flexibility through easily exchangeable modules. Perform dynamic mechanical analysis in torsion, tension, bending, and compression from -160 °C to +1,000 °C with MCR 703 MultiDrive. Temperature distribution is homogeneous with a minimum gradient.
Unique methods for characterizing polymers 
Investigate the melting and crystallization behavior, glass transition, oxidative stability, and curing processes of materials, and assess the compatibility of polymer blends. MCR 703 MultiDrive enables comprehensive characterization of temperature, frequency, and strain-amplitude dependence, as well as quantification of viscoelasticity.
